result.instructions: Tools for resOS, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which bookings do we have tonight, and for how many guests?"; "Are there free tables for 4 people on Friday at 19:30?"; "Book a table for 2 on Saturday at 20:00 for Jan de Vries.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes resOS data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run resos_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run resos_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run resos_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. resos_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: resos_list_bookings
tools.title: List bookings
tools.description: List bookings, newest or oldest first as you sort, with date, time, party size, status, the guest's name, e-mail and phone, assigned tables and custom-field answers. Filter by date range, status, party size or guest name. The comment thread and sent-message log are not included (use resos_get_booking for the thread). Pages of at most 100; pass next_skip to read on. GET /bookings.

from_date_time.description: Start of the range, inclusive: ISO 8601 with a timezone, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z.

to_date_time.description: End of the range, inclusive: ISO 8601 with a timezone, e.g. 2026-10-31T23:59:59Z.

only_confirmed.description: Only approved, arrived, seated or left bookings.

people.description: Only bookings for exactly this many guests.

guest_name_contains.description: Only bookings whose guest name contains this text.

sort.description: Sort, `field:direction[,field2:direction]`, direction 1 ascending or -1 descending, e.g. `dateTime:-1`.

custom_query.description: Extra filter, comma-separated `field<op>value`: `:` equals, `>` greater, `<` less, `;` contains. Example: `guest.phone:+15550100001`.

skip.description: Records to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_skip.

tools.name: resos_get_booking
tools.title: Get booking
tools.description: One booking by id, with the guest's contact data, tables, custom fields, payment, the comment thread (guest and restaurant messages) and the internal restaurant notes. GET /bookings/{id}.

booking_id.description: resOS booking id (the _id of a booking).

tools.name: resos_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List the restaurant's customers (guest profiles): name, e-mails, phones, city and country, tags, notes, flags, booking count and newsletter consent. The street address is not returned. Filter by name. Pages of at most 100. GET /customers.

name_contains.description: Only customers whose name contains this text.

custom_query.description: Extra filter, comma-separated `field<op>value`: `:` equals, `>` greater, `<` less, `;` contains. Example: `guest.phone:+15550100001`.

skip.description: Records to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_skip.

tools.name: resos_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: One customer (guest profile) by id: contact data, tags, notes, flags, booking count and latest booking. GET /customers/{id}.

tools.name: resos_list_guest_feedback
tools.title: List guest feedback
tools.description: List guest feedback (ratings for food, service, value and atmosphere, whether they recommend, and the message). Filter by date range, or only submitted feedback. Pages of at most 100. GET /guestFeedback.

from_date_time.description: Start of the range, inclusive: ISO 8601 with a timezone.

to_date_time.description: End of the range, inclusive: ISO 8601 with a timezone.

only_submitted.description: Only feedback the guest has submitted.

sort.description: Sort, `field:direction[,field2:direction]`, direction 1 ascending or -1 descending, e.g. `dateTime:-1`.

custom_query.description: Extra filter, comma-separated `field<op>value`: `:` equals, `>` greater, `<` less, `;` contains. Example: `guest.phone:+15550100001`.

skip.description: Records to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_skip.

tools.name: resos_get_guest_feedback
tools.title: Get guest feedback
tools.description: One guest feedback entry by id. GET /guestFeedback/{id}.

tools.name: resos_list_seating_areas
tools.title: List seating areas and tables
tools.description: List the seating areas with their tables (id, name, minimum and maximum seats) and table combinations. Use the ids for bookings and availability. GET /tables.

tools.name: resos_list_opening_hours
tools.title: List opening hours
tools.description: List the opening hours: regular weekly hours (day 1 Monday to 7 Sunday) and special date-specific hours, each with id, name, open and close times and whether the restaurant is open. GET /openingHours.

sort.description: Sort, `field:direction[,field2:direction]`, direction 1 ascending or -1 descending, e.g. `dateTime:-1`.

tools.name: resos_get_opening_hour
tools.title: Get opening hour
tools.description: One opening-hour entry by id. GET /openingHours/{id}.

tools.name: resos_list_custom_fields
tools.title: List custom fields
tools.description: List the custom booking fields (name, label, type, required, choices). Use the ids to read or set custom-field answers. GET /customFields.

tools.name: resos_get_custom_field
tools.title: Get custom field
tools.description: One custom booking field by id. GET /customFields/{id}.

tools.name: resos_get_available_dates
tools.title: Get available dates
tools.description: Dates in a range on which the restaurant is open for bookings (default: the next 30 days). GET /bookingFlow/dates.

to_date.description: End date, inclusive, yyyy-mm-dd (default 30 days after from_date).

tools.name: resos_get_available_times
tools.title: Get available times
tools.description: Booking times that are free on a date for a party size, optionally for one seating area. GET /bookingFlow/times.

area_id.description: Only this seating area (id from resos_list_seating_areas).

only_bookable_online.description: Only areas that guests can book online (resOS default true).

tools.name: resos_get_available_tables
tools.title: Get available tables
tools.description: The tables and table combinations that are free for a party size in a time window (UTC). Use it before assigning tables to a booking. GET /bookingFlow/availableTables.

from_date_time.description: Start of the window: ISO 8601 with a timezone, e.g. 2026-10-15T18:00:00Z.

to_date_time.description: End of the window: ISO 8601 with a timezone.

only_bookable_online.description: Only areas that guests can book online (resOS default true).

exclude_booking_id.description: Ignore this booking when counting what is taken (to re-assign its tables).

tools.name: resos_create_booking
tools.title: Create booking
tools.description: WRITE: create a booking for a guest. It is a real booking in the restaurant's book. If notify_email or notify_sms is true, resOS e-mails or texts the GUEST (a confirmation); both default to false. Date and time are in the restaurant's local timezone. Check resos_get_available_times first: resOS may refuse a slot that is full or closed. It is not retried: if the call times out, read the bookings before you try again, or you may book twice. resOS may silently throttle the same e-mail, phone or IP creating more than 10 bookings in 24 hours. POST /bookings.

guest_phone.description: The guest's phone number with the country code.

notify_email.description: Send the guest an e-mail (needs guest_email). Default false.

notify_sms.description: Send the guest a text message (needs guest_phone). Default false.

status.description: Initial status (default: the resOS default for new bookings).

comment.description: A comment from the guest, e.g. `Window seat preferred`.

note.description: An internal restaurant note, not shown to the guest.

area_id.description: Seating area; resOS then picks tables from this area.

tools.name: resos_update_booking
tools.title: Update booking
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing booking: date, time, party size, tables, duration, status, or the guest's name, e-mail or phone. Only the fields you pass change. A status change or a new time can make resOS e-mail or text the GUEST (for example on approved or declined). To cancel use resos_cancel_booking. It is not retried: after a timeout read the booking again before you try again. PUT /bookings/{id}.

date.description: New local date, yyyy-mm-dd (send with time).

time.description: New local time, HH:mm (send with date).

table_ids.description: Tables to assign (replaces the current ones).

status.description: New status. Use resos_cancel_booking to cancel.

guest_phone.description: New guest phone with the country code.

tools.name: resos_cancel_booking
tools.title: Cancel booking
tools.description: WRITE: cancel a booking (status canceled, with a canceled-at time). resOS may e-mail or text the GUEST a cancellation notice. The booking stays in resOS and can be read afterwards. Not retried: after a timeout read the booking first. PUT /bookings/{id}/cancel.

tools.name: resos_add_booking_note
tools.title: Add internal booking note
tools.description: WRITE: add an internal restaurant note to a booking (for example `Birthday, bring a candle`). The guest does not see it and nothing is sent. At most 50 notes per booking; notes cannot be deleted through the API. Not retried: after a timeout read the booking first, or the note may be added twice. POST /bookings/{id}/restaurantNote.

text.description: The note text, up to 2000 characters.

tools.name: resos_send_booking_comment
tools.title: Post booking comment to guest
tools.description: WRITE: post a comment from the restaurant on a booking's guest thread. The guest can see it. If send_notification is true, resOS e-mails or texts the GUEST the message now: you must choose true or false. At most 25 comments per booking and 5 per minute. Cannot be deleted through the API. Not retried: after a timeout read the booking first, or the guest may get it twice. POST /bookings/{id}/comment.

send_notification.description: true = notify the guest by e-mail or text now; false = only add it to the thread.
